conflicts.permit: When you use our Services or Third-Party Mobile Applications, our servers automatically record information that your browser or the applicable Service or Third-Party Mobile Application sends ("Log Data").
conflicts.prohibit: Lilith does not collect any Personal Information or Non-Identifying information, other than Device ID, for non-registered users.
conflicts.situation: When a non-registered user accesses a Lilith Application or Service, generating server log data such as IP address and browser type.
conflicts.reason: The policy states server log data (non-identifying information) is automatically collected upon using Services, yet explicitly claims no information other than Device ID is collected for non-registered users.
